title: Put the mandate-resolver evidence snapshot scripts (soak state, mirror window) on a scheduled workflow so the resolver never reads past soak_snapshot_max_age_days
note: Filed by lane SYSTEM-CONFORMANCE-AUDIT 2026-10-29 (Manager Session 2026-10-29c; operator ~07:30Z audit ask, verbatim on WEEKLY-PLANNING). Evidence: docs/reviews/2026-10-29-system-conformance-audit.md §4.7. Done when: a workflow commits fresh snapshots daily and the resolver reads a snapshot <= 7 days old. 2026-11-03 SOAK-REGRADE: still live today. comms/mandate_evidence/soak_state/2026-10-04.json is the newest snapshot, 30 days old against mandate_resolver soak_snapshot_max_age_days 7. So every soak without a committed PASS disposition reads state None (R-SOAK-NOT-PASSED) across the 50 testing legs; the 35 one-trade-pending legs read that way for this reason or for lack of a registered path.
